Published Table IV coefficients, distinct from the later 2019 all-free-parameter recalibration. V0 is fixed after fitting low-pressure (0-5 GPa) data, not refitted in the full compression regression. K0 and K0-prime are fitted. All printed rows are retained; run-2 Ag/Mo rows with revised pressure &gt;100 GPa are excluded as stated in Section III. Parenthetical errors in Table IV are 95% widths; no covariance is given. The new 2008 ruby upgrade is an output of the later cross-calibration discussion, not the input pressure scale of these fits.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.

## Observation datasets

### nickel\_dewaele\_2008\_table2\_compression

- **Description:** All 42 Ni pressure-volume observations printed in Table II, retaining both tabulated ruby-scale pressures and the author's helium-EOS pressure flag for selected run-6 points.
- **Kind:** pressure\_volume
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Dewaele; Torrent; Loubeyre; Mezouar
    - **Year:** 2008
    - **Source:** Phys. Rev. B
    - **Volume:** 78
    - **Locator:** 104102
    - **DOI:** 10.1103/PhysRevB.78.104102
- **Source location:** Table II, Ni rows
- **Associated EOS records:** nickel\_dewaele\_2008\_vinet\_1; nickel\_dewaele\_2019\_mao\_vinet; nickel\_dewaele\_2019\_dor\_vinet
- **Notes:** Parenthesized run-6 pressures in the printed table were calculated from the helium EOS and are marked true. The article gives a common atomic-volume uncertainty of 0.01 angstrom^3/atom; pressure uncertainty rises from 0.05 GPa at 1 GPa to 2 GPa at 150 GPa, but no rowwise error values are tabulated.

### ni\_nio\_campbell\_2009\_table\_s3\_pvt

- **Description:** All 101 paired fcc-Ni/B1-NiO observations, including nine quenched DAC rows, with NaCl calibration readings and every reported uncertainty.
- **Kind:** pressure\_volume\_temperature\_multiphase\_with\_calibrant
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Campbell; Danielson; Righter; Seagle; Wang; Prakapenka
    - **Year:** 2009
    - **Title:** High pressure effects on the iron–iron oxide and nickel–nickel oxide oxygen fugacity buffers
    - **Source:** Earth and Planetary Science Letters
    - **Volume:** 286
    - **Locator:** 556-564
    - **DOI:** 10.1016/j.epsl.2009.07.022
- **Source location:** Official mmc2.xls, Table S3, worksheet rows 8-108
- **Associated EOS records:** nickel\_campbell\_2009\_bm3\_mgd
- **Notes:** Full stored precision, source row order, and all uncertainties are retained. Rows 100-108 are quenched 293-295 K DAC states; Section 2.2 cautions that residual stress invalidates mechanical equilibrium after quenching. The primary refit excludes those nine rows transparently and reports an all-row sensitivity fit. The authors report B1 NiO throughout; the cubic-average volume model does not resolve the low-temperature rhombohedral/magnetic distortion.

[Observation resource](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/datasets/ni-nio-campbell-2009-table-s3-pvt.csv)
— SHA-256 `a56e125e5337c3f45c4b51ef80df9cd5333bd452c0210bcc2beb252b68840f5d`.
